t: A stick-sized radio lab that tunes from 10 MHz to 3.5 GHz over USB 3.0.
steps: Buy the LimeSDR Mini 2.0 from Crowd Supply or Mouser.
Get antennas with SMA plugs for the bands you want to hear.
Install LimeSuiteNG and SoapySDR from the myriadrf getting started steps.
Plug the board into a USB 3.0 port on your computer.
Open the LimeSuiteNG GUI and confirm the board shows up.
Install GNU Radio and tune to a local FM station as your first test.
Watch the board temperature and add a small fan for long sessions.
Stay receive-only unless you hold an amateur license and use your licensed bands.
meta: Wild Open. From $399. A few stores.
